status_at_creation: fixed before training; no tuning runs
purpose: Isolate omission of the response-query score in the paper's one-query example.
follower_response: One independent query X ~ Bernoulli(p); freeze b = X for gameplay. Reset every episode.
gameplay: A ~ Bernoulli(p), freshly sampled independently of X conditional on the current policy.
policy: One scalar logit z, p = sigmoid(z), identical observation in both phases.
normalization: Mean over complete outer episodes in both arms; never over stored transitions.
randomization: NumPy PCG64, one independent stream per seed. Within a seed, common independent query/gameplay uniform draws are thresholded at each arm's current p.
evaluation: Exact expected value J(p) = p at every update, including initialization; no evaluation sampling or greedy conversion.
primary_endpoint: Exact expected value after 1000 updates (128000 actual transitions per arm).
secondary_endpoint: Mean exact expected value after updates 1 through 1000.
uncertainty: Sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(25) across independent seeds; paired differences use within-seed contrasts.
selection: All seeds, fixed horizon, no checkpoint selection or outcome-dependent stopping.
scope: Controlled empirical illustration of the specified REINFORCE estimator. No general impossibility, convergence, cached-action, or privileged-critic claim.
